notes: Final numbers come from run 3, a zero-call re-score: every query was answered from places_cache.json captured in runs 1-2. resolve_seconds per door are therefore cache-served (~0); live in run 1 the mean was 1.3 s/door for 1-2 Places calls.
OCR ran while two other experiments saturated the CPU (8 cores at ~96%): 3.99 s/view mean; an uncontended smoke test measured ~2.5 s/view.
Distance gate is 400 m, not the suggested 250 m: truth doors at 719/721 Congress are 301-316 m from the bias point, and Burger Bar Congress (312 m) was a correct hit rejected at 250 m in run 1.

truth_type: business = named business in truth; address = truth is a street number/lobby; descriptor = vacant/no-business/no-number. Unresolved on address/descriptor truths counts as correct-unresolved.
partial-address = business truth, resolved to the right street address (number appears in the truth string) but not to the business itself.
